note: Activity Bar -- platform's own navigation icons and controls (Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run and Debug, Extensions, Accounts, Settings)
Explorer viewlet chrome -- renders: view title, new file/folder/refresh/collapse-all controls, other pane headers; excludes the file tree content
Workbench viewlet title bar -- renders: view title label, more actions dropdown controls
Editor tab bar -- platform's own tab controls (close tab button, split editor, more actions)
Getting Started page -- operator-authored editorial copy and fixed interface actions (new file, open folder, source control, remote, etc.)
Status bar -- platform's own status indicators and controls (host, SCM, problems, forwarded ports, notifications, screen reader mode)
Notifications toasts -- platform's own notification UI controls (notification action buttons, clear notifications button)
